title: Muhammad (SAW) is our Prophet
intro: The last Prophet of Allah – and our best example.

learn.alt: The Prophet’s Mosque in Madinah with its green dome and minaret
learn.caption: The Prophet’s Mosque in Madinah

learn.html: Muhammad (SAW) is the last Prophet of Allah. He was born in Makkah on the 12th of Rabi‘ al-Awwal (20 April) in the year 571.
His father’s name was Abdullah and his mother’s name was Aminah. As a child he lost his parents. He grew up with his grandfather Abd al-Muttalib and his uncle Abu Talib.
When he was 40 years old, Allah, the Most High, began to send him the revelation of the noble Qur’an.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: When we say the name Muhammad, we add: ‘alayhis-salaam (AS) – may Allah’s peace be upon him. Many Muslims also say sallallaahu ‘alayhi wa sallam (SAW).

learn.title: 🌟 Our example
learn.html: Muhammad (SAW) is our example in how we behave.

questions.q: Who is the last Prophet of Allah?
In which year was he born?
Who did he grow up with?
options: His grandfather Abd al-Muttalib and his uncle Abu Talib

questions.q: How old was he when the revelation of the Qur’an began?
What do we say when we hear his name?
options: ‘Alayhis-salaam – may Allah’s peace be upon him
